bandReport.notes: Band covers p30 (Q84-90), p32 (Q91-97) and p34 (Q98-100). Q100 completes on p34 and the paper ends there, so lastComplete is true and the band ends at exactly 100. The 'For the next three (03) items' block on p28's right column (circle inside triangle ABC, O 13 cm from each vertex) opens THERE and covers Q81-Q83, which end on p28 - band b4 owns all three; none of them are mine and none are stranded. SEAM AFTER: none - p34 is the last English question page (printed 35-A); PDF indices 35-38 are SPACE FOR ROUGH WORK and 39 is the English cover. THREE Directions sets open inside this band and all their members are here: D84-86 (three items, Q84-Q86), D87-88 (two items, Q87-Q88), D89-90 (two items, Q89-Q90). Each set's context is verbatim-identical across its members and the three are kept separate (different premises, each printing its own stimulus). NO FIGURES anywhere in the band - confirmed at 6-8x on all three pages: the geometry sets are entirely prose-described and Q96/Q98/Q99/Q100 print TABLES, not diagrams. Q100 statement II only MENTIONS a pie diagram; no pie chart is printed. Raised middle-dot decimals throughout (this is the densest band for them) are transcribed as full stops per the brief. The rupee glyph printed in Q92 and in the Q100 table header is written 'Rs.' per the brief's currency rule.
